summary.en: The stream lock-up, two endings: `name` (the mascot winds to the centre and becomes the point the name opens out of; the thread opens with it and settles as a rule under it) or `mascot` (the name opens and the mascot hops from the top of the spine onto the end of the wordmark); the tagline rises a word (a character) at a time.
summary.zh: stream 的落版，两种结尾：`name`（吉祥物缠到画面中央变成一个点，名字从这个点里展开，线随之打开、停成名字下面的一道线）或 `mascot`（名字展开，吉祥物从主干顶端跳到字标末尾）；标语按词（中文按字）升起。

fits: The end of a stream film; any product with a short name and a one-line tagline.
notFor: A long name (over 10 characters); a lock-up that needs a URL or a button.

intent.en: End where everything went: the one point becomes the name.
intent.zh: 在一切归去的地方结束：那一个点变成名字。

content.en: A name (≤ 10 characters) and a tagline (one line).
content.zh: 一个名字（≤ 10 字符）和一句标语（一行）。

fits.zh: stream 片的结尾；名字短、标语一行的任何产品。

notFor.zh: 长名字（超过 10 字符）；需要网址或按钮的落版。

en: The tagline rises per word in English and per character in Chinese: keep it to one line or it wraps under the rule.
Pass the film's whole content as `film`: the scene draws its window of that film (the stars sent before it, the chat feed, the block's place), and its length is fitted with it.
zh: 标语英文按词、中文按字升起：只写一行，否则会折到线下面。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。

overlaps.note: both end with a mascot perching on the wordmark; perch-lockup drops the mascot in and adds a suffix and a pill, point-lockup winds the thread's mascot into a point or hops it from the spine

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
